_comment: Warnings the very deep check's WARNINGS section has decided to stop showing, each with its reason (practice: very-deep-check; tool: tools/warning_review.py). One entry excludes one group: `source`, `kind`, optional `path` (a glob) and optional `match` (a substring of the warning text). `term` is permanent, or temporary with a `revisit` date. `decided` is the date; `by` is `agent` when the session judged it alone. This list is this set's own.

exclusions.why: AGENTS.md, MAP.md and GLOSSARY.md name the generated views of whichever repository a landing runs in, not this set's own files; a link would point every reader at this set's copies
an example path in a consumer's content, not a file in this set
a deduplicated stub naming its own old filename as history
go-update.md and go-merge.md named as filenames in the Detail's high-risk example and in the Story of the rename; history and self-reference, not a pointer a reader follows
a deduplicated practice whose GLOSSARY.md and AGENTS.md mentions are its own history of where the rule once lived
